chunks: He said: Abu al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad, may Allah have mercy on him, reported to me, saying: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Mas'ud narrated to me, from his father Abu al-Nadhr al-Ayyashi, who said: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Mu'adh narrated to me, saying: Zakariyya ibn 'Adi narrated to me, saying: 'Ubayd Allah ibn 'Amr narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah ibn Muhammad ibn 'Aqil, from Hamza ibn Suhayb, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, from his father who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah, may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family, saying from the pulpit:

"What is the matter with people who say that the kinship of the Messenger of Allah will not benefit on the Day of Resurrection? Yes, by Allah! My kinship is surely connected in this world and the Hereafter. And indeed, O people, I shall be your forerunner on the Day of Resurrection at the Pool.

When you arrive, a man will say: 'O Messenger of Allah, I am so-and-so, son of so-and-so.' Then I will say: 'As for the lineage, I have recognized it. But you took the left path after me and retreated backwards on your heels.'"

key_terms.الحوض: The Pool (al-Hawd) — a basin of water granted to the Prophet on the Day of Resurrection
key_terms.القهقرى: Retreating backwards, retrogression — metaphor for apostasy from the Prophet's teachings
key_terms.رحم: Kinship, blood relation, womb tie — a concept central to Islamic social ethics
key_terms.فرط: Forerunner, the one who goes ahead to prepare — used for one who precedes others to the Hereafter

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about kinship with him benefiting on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: The Prophet (SAWW) delivered this sermon from the pulpit in response to people who denied that kinship with him would have any benefit on the Day of Judgment. He affirmed that his blood ties remain binding in both this world and the Hereafter, and warned that on the Day of Resurrection he will be the first to reach the Pool (al-Hawd), but some who claim kinship will be turned away because they deviated from his path after his departure.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him
